elements.name: Change magnification with the mouse wheel

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid visible in the active part in the MCAD Software
the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the direction that zooms out
the block appears smaller in the viewport
the same part and orientation remain active
the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the opposite direction
the block appears larger than after zooming out
the same part and orientation remain active
